article.title: Right of person as to acts done for him without his authority. Effect of ratification.
article.content: Where acts are done by one person on behalf of another, but without his knowledge or authority, he may elect to ratify or to disown such acts. If he ratify them, the same effects will follow as if they had been performed by his authority.
article.html:
196Right of person as to acts done for him without his authority. Effect of ratification.

Section 196 · Chapter X · Ratification · page 45 of the Act

Where acts are done by one person on behalf of another, but without his knowledge or authority, he may elect to ratify or to disown such acts. If he ratify them, the same effects will follow as if they had been performed by his authority.
